en.name: Hand-on-hip side stretch
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Rest one hand lightly on your hip without pressing into your lower back.
Reach the other arm overhead and make a small bend towards the hand on your hip. Breathe out gently.
Return to the middle and lower your arm.
Swap hands and make a small bend to the other side.
Return to the middle. Keep both feet down and use a comfortable reach.
en.focus: Teacher marks each side bend and return. Hand placement is a cue, not a claim of lower-back protection.

zh-Hant.name: 單手叉腰側體伸展
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙腳約與肩同寬，一隻手輕放髖部，不要用力頂壓下背。
另一隻手舉過頭頂，輕輕向叉腰那邊側彎，慢慢呼氣。
交換雙手，輕輕向另一邊側彎。
回到中間，雙腳留在地上，伸展至舒適的位置。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把每次側彎及返回中間記作一次；叉腰是動作提示，不代表能保護下背。
